description: Pinned rows as an engine feature of the Svelte 5 data grid. Pass arrays of rows to pinnedTopRows and pinnedBottomRows and they render inside the same table with position: sticky cells, sharing the column schema, widths, pinning, cellClass and format with the regular rows. No second grid, no stacking; the demo pins account totals at the top and a filtered summary at the bottom.
keywords: svelte 5 data grid pinned bottom row

faq.question: How do I pin a row to the top?
faq.answer: Put the row object in the pinnedTopRows array; pinnedBottomRows works the same for the bottom. The rows use the same TData shape as data, so a totals row is just an object whose fields hold the totals.

faq.question: Do pinned rows scroll with the data?
faq.answer: No. Their cells are sticky, so they stay in view while the data rows scroll, and they stay aligned with the columns because they live in the same table.

faq.question: Can pinned rows react to filters?
faq.answer: Yes. Recompute the array from api.getDisplayedRows() in onFiltersChange and the bottom summary follows the visible rows.
